body.title: Define the shared inclusive budget and typed failure contract
body.summary: Add the approved immutable policy/breakdown and controller declaration types in the shared review contracts plus one pure accounting boundary (proposed src/workflow/review-pipeline/budget.ts). Preserve promptChars/ReviewCall.chars as text diagnostics. Specify estimator, full schema/tool costs, reserves, retry headroom consumption and qualification; budget errors carry safe metadata only.
acceptanceChecks: Default total remains128000; all declared text/schema/tool components plus native16384, transport1024, completion8192 and reviewer-inspection24576 token reserves participate; planning retry headroom8000 chars is counted exactly once.
Each component uses safe nonnegative values/ceil estimates; exact-cap succeeds, one-token excess refuses, missing/unqualified production profile never becomes zero overhead.

Expose estimatedTotal/remaining and qualification managed-estimate, reserved-native or explicit controller-reserved; never report estimated/native reserve values as measured usage or a verified hard ceiling.
ReviewBudgetError provides stable fail-closed codes without raw prompt/schema/tool/error text; optional non-review provider fields retain existing behavior.
